description: config:recommended ignores **/examples/**, but examples/respondeo is the published create-respondeo-app template and must stay dependency-identical to apps/web (enforced by scripts/check-template-sync.sh). Default list minus the examples glob.

customManagers.description: Update the pnpm version in devEngines.packageManager, and the matching packageManagerDependencies entry in pnpm-lock.yaml (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails if they disagree). Renovate's npm manager only updates the top-level packageManager field, which this repository no longer sets. Both files share the pnpm dependency name, so their updates land in one branch.
